scope: Original category activation helper, concrete begin, empty predicate and ordinary finalizer
substitutions: Scope and recursive locking helpers replaced with no-ops
Dependency activation records and sets synthetic active marker
Dependency release recorded without traversing successor list
Queue insertion records and sets scheduled state
Worker wake routine recorded without threads
coverage: Lifecycle state values 0,1,2,3; value 3 is a branch probe, not a claimed valid lifecycle
Signed remaining counts -1,0,1,6; negative is a branch probe
Started request acknowledgement and unchanged work/execution counts
limits: No native locks, threads, queue selection or dependency traversal
No dispatched worker completion or next-gather lifetime proof
Finalizer bookkeeping registration flag initially zero
